messages:
natalie_p: quick follow-up from the postmortem — streaming/chat endpoint had recurring partial-response/timeouts and a bunch of reconnect churn. postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/streaming-chat-2026-03. we need concrete owners, short timelines, and a runnable mitigation plan (not just tickets). please volunteer for one of the three workstreams below. :eyes:

ops-bot: incident created: STREAM-2026-03-17 partial responses & reconnect storm (sev3) — summary attached.

devon: i'll take reconnect/backoff heuristics + server-side soft-close behavior. plan: prototype new backoff defaults, add a server-side circuit to short-circuit noisy clients, and surface reconnect_attempts_per_session metric in console. ETA: proposal by 2026-03-19, PR + test by 2026-03-24. @natalie_p tagging for rollout approval. :thumbsup:

marta: i'll own detection & observability for partial responses. immediate work: add 'partial_response_count' metric, instrument span attribute "response.truncated=true" for partial sends, and add an alert when partials spike >3/min per cluster. ETA: metrics + alert by 2026-03-22, dashboard by 2026-03-25.

kevin_oncall: i'll handle timeouts SLA audit and SDK/client guidance. tasks: run p50/p95/p99 across regions for streaming endpoints, propose new server timeout config, and add a recommended client 'gracefulReconnect' flag with defaults. will coordinate canary on Dedicated region eu-west-2. ETA: audit complete by 2026-03-23, SDK PR by 2026-03-29.

natalie_p: thanks team. small request — keep changes incremental and add rollback gates. propose the following quick mitigations today: 1) temporary lower reconnect_rate_limit to 10/s per IP, 2) enable partial_response alert at a low threshold, 3) add a client-facing note in SDK release notes. who can flip (1) for the short window?

devon: i can flip (1) now, will monitor for 30m and revert if visible regressions.

ops-bot: deploy job #deploy-4321 started by devops-ci (staging).

marta: for detection, i'm also adding a lightweight header flag we can emit from the runtime when we detect an early write: `X-Partial-Detect: v1`. this will let us filter and count without parsing bodies. plan: add header in the runtime + wire to metrics. example header usage: ```curl -H "X-Partial-Detect: v1" https://stream.redwood/api/v1```

kevin_oncall: for SDK behavior, i'll add this coupling: if client sees `X-Partial-Detect: v1` and `reconnect_count >= 3` in 5m, then backoff client by 5s and report to telemetry. will add a config flag `client.partialBackoffEnabled` default true.

devon: provisional backoff config i'm testing: ```yaml
reconnect:
  max_retries: 5
  base_delay_ms: 200
  max_delay_ms: 5000
  jitter: full
  soft_conn_close_after: 3  # server will drop restful keepalive after this
```

marta: also adding a regression test: simulate partial body writes and assert server emits `X-Partial-Detect: v1` + increments metric. will include this in the streaming e2e suite.

natalie_p: action list (short):
- reconnect/backoff heuristics: owner @devon, deliverable: config + server soft-close + metrics, due 2026-03-24
- partial-response detection & alerts: owner @marta, deliverable: header + metric + dashboard + alert, due 2026-03-25
- timeout/SLA audit & SDK guidance: owner @kevin_oncall, deliverable: audit report + SDK PR + canary, due 2026-03-29

kevin_oncall: i'll add rollback criteria for SDK (ability to opt-out `client.partialBackoffEnabled=false`) and for server flags we will gate behind feature flags.

devon: noted. i'll open a single tracking ticket with subtasks and add owners + required tests. ticket will link back to this thread.

marta: weekly sync? propose 15m triage every Tue 9:30am PT until we clear the three items.

natalie_p: agreed, add calendar invite and set recurring. please post short status updates here after each PR lands. thanks all. :rocket:
